decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted external roofless ground floor plant enclosure extension have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P02, P03, P04, P05, P06 and unnumbered design and access statement, received 23/01/13, P01 rev A, received 24/01/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until a detailed noise assessment demonstrating that the development will not cause an increase in existing background noise levels in the area has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

The noise assessment shall be carried out by a suitably qualified acoustic consultant and shall take into account the provisions of BS4142 and demonstrate that when operating at its maximum level the equipment will be 10 dB(A) below existing background noise levels.
description: Erection of an external roofless ground floor plant enclosure extension to the existing building
